scenes.title: Freshness & Volume Monitoring
scenes.subtitle: Catching late and missing data early
scenes.narration: Freshness and volume monitoring detect the two most common pipeline failures: data that arrives late and data that arrives in the wrong amount.

scenes.heading: What each metric detects
bullets: Freshness: the lag between now and the latest record
Volume: the number of rows loaded in a window
Together they flag stalled, partial, or duplicated loads
scenes.narration: Freshness measures how old the newest record is, which exposes pipelines that stalled or failed silently. Volume tracks how many rows landed in a given window, revealing partial or duplicated loads. Watched together, these two signals catch the majority of everyday delivery problems.

scenes.heading: Detecting a freshness breach
steps: Record the max timestamp on each load
Compute lag against the current time
Compare lag to the freshness threshold
Alert when lag exceeds the SLA
scenes.narration: On every load we capture the maximum event timestamp in the table. We then compute the lag between that timestamp and now, giving a live measure of staleness. When the lag crosses the agreed threshold, an alert fires so the on-call owner can respond before consumers notice.

scenes.heading: Freshness and volume in SQL
scenes.code:
-- Freshness: minutes since the newest record
SELECT
  DATEDIFF('minute', MAX(created_at), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS lag_minutes
FROM orders;

-- Volume: today vs the trailing 7-day average
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS row_ct
  FROM orders GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT row_ct FROM daily WHERE d = CURRENT_DATE) AS today,
  AVG(row_ct) AS avg_7d
FROM daily
WHERE d >= CURRENT_DATE - 7;
scenes.narration: The freshness query returns how many minutes have passed since the most recent order, which you compare against your SLA. The volume query builds a daily row count and contrasts today's total with the trailing seven-day average. A large gap in either direction signals a partial load or an unexpected surge worth investigating.

scenes.text: Baseline freshness and volume, alert on deviation, and you catch most broken pipelines before anyone downstream does.
scenes.narration: These two cheap metrics cover a surprising share of real incidents. Set thresholds from historical behavior rather than guesses so the alerts stay meaningful.
